name: ceramics-webapp

dependencies.name: ceramics-api
dependencies.description: Backend API for catalog, cart, checkout, orders, inventory, and admin management.

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Thunder-issued OIDC sign-in for shoppers and the store admin; provides the browser-side OIDC client config.

description: The customer-facing and admin storefront SPA: product catalog browsing, product detail, cart, guest and signed-in checkout, order confirmation, order history, and a role-gated admin area for catalog, inventory, and order-status management. Talks to ceramics-api for all data and business logic; holds no secrets and never calls the payment provider or database directly.
